entries.summary: Split the single-file app into a core package (pure image functions per lecture chapter) and an app package (Tkinter UI with sidebar operation catalog). Pinned dependencies to OpenCV 4.x, added pytest smoke tests, removed emojis from UI.
entries.title: Modular monolith architecture

entries.summary: Fixed blurry low-res look on scaled Windows displays by declaring system DPI awareness and scaling UI geometry, canvas minimums, and histogram figure dpi by the real screen DPI. Window capped to screen work area. Behavior unchanged at 100 percent scaling.
entries.title: Native DPI rendering on scaled Windows displays

entries.summary: Made histogram detail visible and before/after comparison fair. The sample image puts 42 percent of red pixels in bin 255, so independent linear autoscale crushed other bins to a flat line and used different Y scales per panel. Both subplots now share one dynamic Y max (across both images and all channels) on a symlog axis, so spikes no longer hide detail and the scale stays identical for comparison.
entries.title: Histogram shared dynamic log scale

entries.summary: Removed the Red/Green/Blue legend from the AFTER histogram panel because it overlapped the plotted curves and hid part of the reading. Channel colors and the shared symlog scale are unchanged; the legend was redundant since each curve is color-coded.
entries.title: Remove histogram RGB legend
